name: Swipe Image Deck
description: Full-screen board with a stack of draggable image cards. Drag a card left, right or up to throw it away and reveal the next one, with tilt and scale feedback.
contents: Stack of two visible image cards centered on a full-height board
behavior: Drag the top card with mouse or touch, it rotates based on grab point and drag distance
The card underneath scales up as the top card moves
Releasing past the threshold flings the card off screen left, right or up and calls the matching callback
Releasing before the threshold snaps the card back
Tapping the card gives a small tilt bounce
With no images given, random sample images are generated and new ones are appended endlessly
editableByProps: Image list, card size, board background class
Swipe distance threshold and fling duration

needsCodeEdit.where: card-item class on the card div

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the sample image source used when no images are passed
needsCodeEdit.where: picsum.photos URLs in the useState initializer and setImagePool

fixed: Board fills the viewport height and blocks touch scrolling inside it
Without images prop, cards use random picsum.photos images and require network access
With a provided image list, the deck ends after the last image
